classification: Implementation bug fix: forward the selected bounded WAK validity to the actual OracleSafetyCheck v3 signer
receiptImpact: A new 1800-second checkedAt/validUntil interval may be signed only when the operator enables WAK_P1_SIGNED_TTL_SECONDS=1800 with an unexpired 10-digit Unix WAK_P1_EXTENDED_VALIDITY_UNTIL issuance cutoff and authenticated audit metadata identifies workflow wak.insight-priorseal.p1.v1, schema 3, chain 84532, a WETH/USDC swap in either direction and declared tradeAmountUsd=4. Missing, invalid or reached issuance cutoff selects the default 600-second policy. The validity interval is inside the existing EIP-712 signed message. Default v3 and all v1/v2, sample, Oracle Watch and execution receipt paths retain their current rules; the previously approved 900-second opt-in remains available. Previously signed evidence is never extended or edited. No schema layout, attester key, registry release or partner activation mapping changes.
activationRule: This promotion releases the opt-in implementation on main. The WAK-specific server configuration remains required for 1800-second issuance; this bounded testnet workflow does not enable a new partner production verification route. Every active partner remains on its current immutable policy and the default signing path. WAK transaction signing/broadcast remains subject to a separately reviewed fresh bundle and explicit GO.
